solutionSql:
SELECT id, tracking_code, weight_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE status = 'queued'
  AND weight_kg >= 500
ORDER BY weight_kg DESC, id ASC
LIMIT 5;

rules.howSolved: Added weight_kg >= 500 to the WHERE clause, so NULL weights are excluded.
Added status = 'queued' as an exact literal match in the WHERE clause.
Added LIMIT 5 after the ORDER BY.
Used ORDER BY weight_kg DESC as the primary sort key.
Used ORDER BY id ASC as the secondary sort key.

notes: The nulls dataset has no queued shipments at all (every row there is delivered), so it returns 0 rows, which the ticket allows. Status literals are exact lowercase in every dataset. Row counts per dataset: sample=5, nulls=0, ties=5, boundary=5. Ran on every listed dataset without error.
